title: News Monitor API — Company & Keyword News, Adverse Media (GDELT)

queries.title: Queries
queries.description: One or more GDELT search queries. Quote exact phrases ("OpenAI"), combine with GDELT boolean syntax, e.g. (apple OR microsoft). Each query is run and charged separately.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: "news" returns all matching coverage. "adverse_media" ANDs every query with a curated risk-term group: (fraud OR bribery OR corruption OR "money laundering" OR sanctions OR lawsuit OR indictment OR investigation OR scandal OR bankruptcy OR "data breach" OR recall), for KYC/AML-style screening.

languages.title: Languages
languages.description: Optional GDELT sourcelang codes to restrict to (e.g. eng, fre, spa). OR'd together, ANDed with the query.

countries.title: Source countries
countries.description: Optional GDELT sourcecountry FIPS codes to restrict to (e.g. US, UK, FR). OR'd together, ANDed with the query.

domains.title: Domains
domains.description: Optional publisher domains to restrict to (e.g. reuters.com). OR'd together, ANDed with the query.

lookbackHours.title: Lookback hours
lookbackHours.description: How far back to search from now. GDELT DOC covers roughly the last 3 months.

sinceLastRun.title: Only new articles since last run
sinceLastRun.description: Incremental monitoring mode for schedules: only articles newer than the last successful run are delivered and charged.

maxResultsPerQuery.title: Max results per query
maxResultsPerQuery.description: Cap on charged article records per query.
